structure.unit: Boundary Adjustments and Changes of Status of Counties, Cities and Towns

law.catch_line: Investigation by special court; public hearing
law.text: A special court appointed pursuant to this chapter shall investigate all matters contained in the report certified to the court under § 15.2-4002, and any other matters it deems pertinent to the purpose of the inquiry. The court shall fix a time and place for a public hearing on such report.
